messages.subject: Meridian / Harcourt – MSSA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Martin, Zoe,

On behalf of Meridian Signal Analytics, please find attached the first draft Master Subscription & Data Services Agreement for your client Harcourt Beverages. The Order Form, SOW, SLA and DPA will follow separately tomorrow.

We've prepared this on Meridian's standard supplier terms. Key commercial points (annual fee £840k, £120k implementation, 3-year term) follow the agreed heads. We look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
